collection.description: A child tastes a drop of seawater and asks why it differs from drinking water.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) tastes a drop of seawater and asks why it differs from drinking water.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a teacher, describes salts carried into the sea over time.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) learns not to drink seawater and observes differences safely.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) asks whether boiling seawater makes it drinkable.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) shares a story about a giant salt pot as folklore.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) giggles and then asks for the natural explanation.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (adult) explains why fresh drinking water matters at sea.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) learns that salty water cannot replace drinking water.
